tt_audio_sync_offset: Shifts all transcript timestamps. Negative values (-0.05) make words start slightly earlier.
tt_audio_sync_pad: Adds extra duration to the end of each word. Prevents trailing sounds from being cut off.
tt_audio_sync_snap: Maximum allowed gap between two words to merge them into a single continuous segment.
lbl_hidden_start: Start of audio detected as inaudible, skipped.
chk_sync_davinci: Sync DaVinci Timeline on Chapter Switch
tt_advanced_locked: Available in upcoming subversions of StoryCraft 3.0
dlg_track_selection_desc: Choose which tracks to include in the assembly. This window appears on the first assembly of a project or via the wrench icon.
lbl_font_preview: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
sub_pauses: What happens to the silences between words
tt_pause_mode:
Keep: leave pauses as they are.
Mark: keep them, as Tan-coloured clips in Resolve.
Cut: remove them, as much as the settings below allow.
tt_playback_speed: Playback speed (Shift+. faster, Shift+, slower). Voices keep their pitch.
tt_play_edit: Play the story as Send to Resolve will build it: removed parts are skipped, and an imported AI story plays in its order. Nothing is sent to Resolve.
tt_board: Arrange the interview from blocks of sentences. Drag blocks to reorder them, or between Story and Not used. Play story and Send to Resolve follow the Story list, in its order. Double-click a block to play it.
tt_board_fill: Fill the Story list with the whole interview, in blocks, in the recording's order (after the current cuts).
board_empty: Nothing in the story yet. Fill it from the transcript, import an AI story, or drag blocks up from Not used.
tt_board_review_cuts: Copies a cut-by-cut review of the story (what is said either side, jumps, cuts mid-thought, loudness jumps, repeats) for the AI to suggest better order and cut points. Paste it in the same AI chat.
msg_cut_review_copied: Cut review copied ({cuts} cuts): paste it in the AI chat
video_multi_clip: Several clips in this timeline: audio only
tt_story_copy_fix: Copies a message for the AI listing these problems. Paste it in the same chat, then paste the new answer here.
msg_story_fix_copied: Copied: paste it in the AI chat
tt_board_copy_ai: Copy the transcript with sentence lengths, clarity and your target length, ready to paste into an AI chat.
tt_group_external_ai: Build the story with the AI chat of your choice (Claude, ChatGPT…). 1. Copy for AI and paste it into the chat. 2. Ask for a story, copy the clip list it gives, then Import AI story. 3. Review cuts: paste the review into the same chat to improve the order and cut points.
tt_board_import_ai: Paste the story the AI chat wrote (one clip per line, like M12 or S041-S043) to fill the Story list. Use Copy for AI first.
tt_board_target: How long the finished story should be, e.g. 2:00 or 90s. The AI is asked to aim for it; the Story page shows how close the story is.
msg_saved_exists_desc: "{timeline}" was transcribed before (saved {when}). Open that transcript with your marks, or transcribe it again from scratch?
tt_open_saved: This timeline was transcribed before. Open it with your marks and story, without transcribing again.
update_fork_desc: StoryCraft {latest} is available (you have {current}). Open the download page?
about_what: StoryCraft turns interviews into stories inside DaVinci Resolve: clean the recording as text, build the story with or without AI, and send it to Resolve as a new timeline.
about_credit: StoryCraft is a fork of BadWords by Szymon Wolarz (MIT License). The text-based editing at its heart is his work.
about_privacy: StoryCraft sends nothing unless you turn on the usage ping below: one anonymous ping per version to the original author's analytics, with no location and nothing from your projects. Transcription runs on this computer (or in your own DaVinci Resolve). Text only reaches an AI when you copy it there yourself or connect your own Claude app.
logs_info: If something goes wrong, this log file shows what happened. Share it when asking for help.
sub_script: Recorded from a script? Paste or import it to compare: words you skipped or changed are marked. Without a script, What the AI found does the work.
tt_script_errors: Looks for slips and retakes in the transcript alone (no script needed). Also in What the AI found.
sub_markers: What a left-click marks in the text: the same as the chips above it. Add your own markers for anything else.
tt_tx_source: Whisper: StoryCraft transcribes the timeline itself. Resolve: uses DaVinci Resolve Studio's own transcription of the clips, with speaker detection; clips Resolve hasn't transcribed yet (or not with speakers) are transcribed by Resolve first. Falls back to Whisper if Resolve can't.
status_resolve_tx_clip: Resolve is transcribing clip {n} of {total} (with speakers)…
tt_det_stammers: Finds words said again straight away (“I think I think”) and self-corrections (“we drove to the… uh, we walked to the park”) and marks what was abandoned as Retake, so only the final version stays. Also cuts a sentence that only echoes the one before (“It changed everything. Changed everything.”) and lone “Yeah.” / “Mhm.” answers. Runs by itself after each transcription.
tt_review_sounds: Plays each sound without words (a cough, a knock, a voice in the background) from a second before, one after the other. Sounds much louder than the voice are cut by themselves; Keep it / Cut it decides for the one you just heard. Sounds the story keeps get a Cocoa “Sound” marker in Resolve.
msg_sound_review: Sound {n} of {total} at {time}: {level} against the voice, {state}.
msg_sounds_none: No sounds without words were found.
tt_det_speaker: Find what the second speaker (usually the interviewer) says: quieter and a different voice. First use downloads a 30 MB voice model. Check the result by listening; right-click to clear mistakes.
msg_speaker_need_marker: Create a custom marker for the second speaker first (Settings → Custom markers), for example "Second speaker".
msg_speaker_no_audio: The transcript's audio file isn't available, so voices can't be compared.
msg_speaker_failed: Speaker detection failed. See the log for details.
msg_speaker_done: {count} words marked as {marker}. Listen and right-click any that aren't.
tt_spk_title: Who says what, up to 10 voices. Each turn in the transcript starts with the speaker's name: click it to give the turn to someone else. To move part of a turn, select the text and right-click > Speaker. Roles tell the external AI who is who.
tt_start_speakers: How many people speak. Right after transcribing, StoryCraft tells their voices apart, so every turn gets a name (fix any in the Speakers card). Auto finds the number; 1 skips it.
tt_spk_count: How many people speak. Auto finds it (up to 10).
tt_det_speakers: Find who speaks when, from the voices (up to 10). First use downloads a 30 MB voice model. Replaces the current speakers. Undo with Cmd+Z.
spk_empty: No speakers yet. Detect them, or select text in the transcript and right-click > Speaker.
tt_fin_title: What StoryCraft does to the new timeline once it is built. Your source timeline is never changed.
tt_fin_voice: Resolve's Voice Isolation on the dialogue (Studio): less room noise and background sound.
tt_fin_captions_resolve: Resolve makes subtitles from the new timeline's audio, on a subtitle track (Studio).
tt_fin_captions_srt: A subtitle file of the story from StoryCraft's transcript, for YouTube, Premiere or any player.
tt_fin_captions_names: Start each speaker's captions with their name, e.g. HOLLY:.
tt_fin_cameras: By speaker: stack the synced cameras on V1, V2… of the source timeline; each turn shows its speaker's camera (set per speaker in Speakers). SmartSwitch: Resolve Studio picks the angle of a multicam clip.
tt_fin_exports: Copies of the new timeline for other editors, saved in the folder below.
tt_fin_exp_premiere: FCP 7 XML: opens in Premiere Pro (and Resolve).
tt_fin_exp_fcp: FCPXML bundle for Final Cut Pro.
tt_fin_exp_otio: OpenTimelineIO, for other editors and tools.
tt_det_swears: Find swear words in the transcript's language. They are bleeped by default: the picture stays, the voice goes under a tone. Change it to Keep, Mark or Cut in the colours below.
msg_swear_no_color: No free marker colour left for swear words: remove a custom marker in Settings.
tt_spk_camera: The video track (V1, V2…) of this speaker's camera in the source timeline.
tt_board_from_script: Fill the Story list in script order: for each line of your script, the take that survived the cleanup. Lines said off-script stay in Not used.
msg_script_story_need: Import or paste a script first (Script panel).
msg_script_story_none: No script line could be found in the kept transcript.
msg_script_story_done: Story built from the script: {lines} lines, {blocks} blocks
tt_edits_title: Every timeline you sent to Resolve from this source timeline. Click one to continue from it: its marks, speakers and story come back, and it opens in Resolve. The source timeline is backed up in the StoryCraft folder.
edits_empty: No timelines yet. Send to Resolve to make the first one.
tt_edits_row: Load this timeline: its marks, speakers and story; it opens in Resolve.
msg_spk_done: {count} speakers found. Click a name to fix a turn, or select text and right-click > Speaker.
tt_spk_role: Main voice, interviewer or other: tells the external AI who is who.
tt_spk_leave_out: Cut everything this speaker says from the story.
tt_det_restore: Put this kind back the way the AI marked it (undo with Cmd+Z)
tt_det_detect: Run error and retake detection on the whole transcript
tt_det_fillers: Mark filler words from your list automatically
mark_hint: Left-click marks · Right-click clears · Shift-drag selects a passage
tt_restore_ai: Bring back everything the analysis marked (errors, retakes, typos, no voice). Your own marks in those words are replaced. Undo with Cmd+Z.
msg_retranscribe_same: Transcribed again: same words as before
msg_retranscribe_done: Passage transcribed again: {before} words → {after} (undo with Cmd+Z)
msg_retranscribe_failed: Transcribing again failed. See the log for details.
msg_ai_restored: {count} words back to the AI's marks
tt_wf_cleanup: Choose what gets removed: pauses, fillers and marked colours (Keep / Mark / Cut). The transcript shows the result.
tt_wf_compose: Arrange the interview from blocks on the story board, in any order. Turn on Play edit to watch it.
tt_send_resolve: Build the story as a new timeline in DaVinci Resolve. Nothing in Resolve changes before this.
tt_view_edited: Recording: the whole recording with its marks. Story: only the story's text, in play order, one paragraph per block; it follows the story and the cuts.
tt_send_synced: Resolve has this story: {name}. Click to send it again as a new timeline.
tt_send_changed: The story changed since {name} was sent. Send to make a new timeline with the changes.
tt_fin_sync: After you send the story once, the timeline in Resolve follows your changes: a few seconds after you stop, it is rebuilt in place, same name. Never if you edited that timeline in Resolve.
tt_sync_soon: Resolve gets the changes in a few seconds ({name}).
tt_sync_paused: Sync paused: {name} was edited in Resolve. Send to make a new timeline.
msg_sync_paused: Sync paused: {name} was edited in Resolve, so StoryCraft won't overwrite it
msg_sync_gone: Sync paused: {name} is no longer in Resolve
msg_sync_failed: Updating Resolve failed. See the log.
msg_sync_busy: Resolve is being updated; try again in a moment
tt_color_mode:
Keep: these parts stay in, without colour.
Mark: they stay in, as coloured clips in Resolve.
Cut: they are removed.
tt_resolve_tools: Cut all clips of one colour directly on the timeline that's open in Resolve (scissors), or pick colours to remove automatically (A).

msg_cut_offer_note_auto: Auto-cut (A) for {color} will stay on for future sends to Resolve.
msg_cut_result_failed: The cut could not be applied: {error}
tt_silence_cut_pct: Cuts the longest pauses first until this share of the total pause time is removed. 100 = every detected pause. Lower it for slow speakers to keep their rhythm.
tt_silence_min_clip: Never leaves a piece shorter than this between two silence cuts: of two close pauses, only the longer one is cut. Avoids jumpy micro-cuts. 0 = off.
tt_silence_keep: Leaves this much of every cut pause in place so speech doesn't sound rushed. 0 = cut the whole pause.
msg_please_import_or_paste_a: Please import or paste a script first.
msg_restart_lang: Changes saved. To see the results, please restart StoryCraft.

msg_telemetry:
Hi! 👋

To help me improve StoryCraft, do you agree to send a one-time, 100% anonymous ping after installation / update?

Only the app version and OS type (e.g., Windows) are sent. Audio files, scripts, or personal data are NEVER collected.

Geolocation (country/city) is optional — uncheck the box below to disable it.

You can change these preferences anytime in Settings → Telemetry.
tt_always_on_top:
Keeps the application window always on top of other windows (even if you click outside of it).

Note: On Windows, changing this setting may require restarting the application to take full effect.
msg_support_info: Send an issue report directly to the developer. Logs will be attached automatically.
msg_support_success: Report has been queued for sending.
msg_import_invalid_format: Invalid file format. Expected a JSON file with a "custom_markers" list.
msg_import_no_valid_markers: No valid markers found in the file.
msg_telemetry_settings: We collect minimal anonymous data (OS version, app version) to improve StoryCraft. No audio or personal files are ever sent.
msg_telemetry_off: StoryCraft doesn't send any usage data. The original BadWords asks for a one-time anonymous ping; this fork has it switched off.
link_repo_desc: Browse the source code, report issues, and follow the project
msg_compute_fail_desc: Your CPU/GPU does not support the selected compute type. Please select a different type or use 'Auto'.
tt_chunk_max_words: Determines the maximum number of words possible in a single line of the transcript.
tt_chunk_lookahead: Determines how far ahead the algorithm looks for words with punctuation OVER the limit from the first parameter, so as not to move e.g. the last 1 word of a sentence to a new line.
tt_chunk_min_chars: The minimum number of characters in a single line.
msg_restart_required: Changes applied. Full effect will be visible on the next launch.
msg_restart_lang_pending: Language changed. Full changes will apply on restart.
msg_unsaved_desc: You have unsaved changes. What would you like to do?
msg_assembly_failed: Building the timeline failed. Check the log file.
msg_crash_desc:

Last autosave: {time}
tt_xml_preserve_track_order: Maintains original track numbers for both audio and video tracks (e.g. A3 stays A3, V2 stays V2). If disabled, tracks are placed sequentially starting from 1.
tt_auto_check_updates: Checks for updates silently in the background and shows a notification when a new version is available.
tt_auto_update_on_start: Automatically downloads and installs updates before StoryCraft starts. Requires the notification option to be enabled.
tt_mark_silence_with_color: Highlights the detected silence with a color.
tt_detect_and_mark_silence: Highlights the detected silence with a color.
tt_mark_filler_words: Automatically highlights the filler words you entered above in red.
tt_sync_davinci_chapter: Automatically switches the active timeline in DaVinci to match the timeline you pick at the top of the screen.

tt_more_accurate:
This option allows you to paste/import a script before transcription. Keywords are extracted from this script and fed to Whisper (the audio transcription model), making the transcription more accurate.

This option is highly recommended for strictly technical scripts containing many words with non-phonetic spellings (e.g., system paths, names with numbers, special characters, etc.).

Additionally, this option automatically runs the transcript-script comparison algorithm, so after transcription is complete, colors are immediately visible, and the Side-by-side view loads instantly.
tt_jump_to_word_info:
Jumps the DaVinci and internal audio player playhead to the exact moment the clicked word was spoken.

Available shortcuts: CTRL/ALT/SHIFT + Left/Right Click.

msg_audio_preview_missing: This project lacks needed files for audio preview.
msg_audio_preview_get_now: Click here to fix this now
msg_audio_preview_failed: Could not recover audio: matching source timeline or clips were not found in DaVinci Resolve.
story_dlg_hint: Paste the AI's answer. StoryCraft reads the sentence IDs (M12, M12-M14, S004-S007) after the line EDIT, or anywhere in the text if there is no such line, and builds the story in that order. Fillers, silences and colors you remove stay removed.
tt_story_keep_order: Use only the chosen sentences, but play them in the order they were recorded instead of the AI's order.
story_rebuilt_note: No AI-ready transcript was copied for this timeline yet, so the IDs were rebuilt from the current cut settings. If the AI saw a transcript made with other settings, copy it again and redo the request.
story_banner: AI story loaded: {clips} clips · {duration}, in the AI's order. "{assemble}" builds it as a new timeline.
story_banner_source: AI story loaded: {clips} clips · {duration}, in recording order. "{assemble}" builds it as a new timeline.
msg_story_loaded: AI story loaded ({clips} clips). Press "{assemble}" to build it.
msg_ai_no_speakers_yet: speakers are still being detected: copy again in a moment for their names
msg_ai_no_speakers: no speakers yet: Detect them in the Speakers card so the AI knows who talks
legend_empty: No colors yet. Mark words or run Analyze to see what each color means here.
legend_meaning_bad: Errors and fillers (um, uh…), plus words you marked red
legend_meaning_repeat: Retakes: earlier tries of a phrase said again (Detect)
legend_meaning_typo: Differences from your script (Analyze with a script)
tt_legend_remove: Leave this color out of the next Send to Resolve (same as its "A" button). Several colors can be removed at once.
tt_legend_not_removable: This color can't be left out at Send to Resolve. Use its scissors on the new timeline instead.
tooltip_auto_cut: Automatically cuts this color at Send to Resolve if marked in the text.
tooltip_cut_now: Cuts this color directly on the CURRENTLY SELECTED DaVinci timeline (useful for mass deletion after manual tweaks).

msg_file_not_selected: Please select a video or audio file first.
msg_source_not_ready: Please select a valid media source.

msg_resolve_not_connected: No active connection to DaVinci Resolve. Ensure DaVinci Resolve Studio is running and External Scripting is enabled.

tt_source_info_free:
Choose media source: you can edit an audio/video file directly from your disk, or use StoryCraft as a plugin for DaVinci Resolve (which enables applying cuts directly onto the timeline and color-coding clips).

DaVinci Resolve Connection:
Open DaVinci Resolve and run Workspace → Scripts → StoryCraft Bridge. You can also launch StoryCraft directly from inside DaVinci Resolve (via Workspace → Scripts → StoryCraft), but this option is only available for DaVinci Resolve versions older than 21.1.
tt_source_info_studio:
Choose media source: you can edit an audio/video file directly from your disk, or use StoryCraft as a plugin for DaVinci Resolve (which enables applying cuts directly onto the timeline and color-coding clips).

DaVinci Resolve Studio Connection:
You can launch StoryCraft directly or from inside DaVinci Resolve (via Workspace → Scripts → StoryCraft). Ensure that in DaVinci Resolve Preferences → System → General → External scripting using is set to Local.
tt_source_info_not_installed:

DaVinci Resolve:
Professional video editing software. Not detected on this system – downloading DaVinci Resolve is recommended for full timeline integration.
tt_assembly_locked_transcription: This option is locked until transcription is complete
tt_force_xml_assembly: Forces timeline assembly to use the FCP7 XML pipeline instead of native DRT. Useful for testing XML assembly or on Resolve 21.1+ Free.
stats_msg:
StoryCraft is built on BadWords by Szymon Wolarz, and he'd like to know how many people use it.

If you agree, StoryCraft sends one anonymous ping per version to his analytics (PostHog, EU servers): the StoryCraft version, your operating system, whether it's a new install or an update, and a random ID made on this computer.

Nothing else: no location, no transcripts, no file or project names, no media.

You can change this anytime in Settings → About StoryCraft.
about_stats_toggle: Send one anonymous ping per version to the original author (StoryCraft version, operating system, new install or update)
home_card_resolve_desc: Transcribe a timeline with Whisper, or use Resolve's speakers.
home_card_file_desc: Transcribe a video or audio file: MP4, MOV, WAV, MP3, M4A.

voice_intro: Find sentence endings that sound unfinished after a cut and replace their last words with a version in the speaker's own voice, made by VoiceStudio.
voice_make_tt: VoiceStudio speaks the sentence in the speaker's voice with a full stop; StoryCraft keeps the take that ends most like a finished sentence.
voice_use_recording_tt: Say it the way you want: StoryCraft uses your words and picks the take whose melody and pace are closest to yours.
voice_consent: Patches are synthetic speech. Use them only with the speaker's permission, and say so where your audience would expect to know.
voice_setup: 1. Install VoiceStudio (free, voicestudio.sh) and open it.  2. In its Model Manager, choose a voice engine that can clone (CosyVoice 3 for paid work).  3. Leave it open, then press Check again.
voice_lic_nc_help: This model's licence doesn't allow paid work. For client projects, pick CosyVoice 3 in VoiceStudio's Model Manager.
voice_wm_tt: VoiceStudio's invisible watermark lets anyone check later that the audio is synthetic. Turn it on in VoiceStudio's settings.
voice_no_transcript: Open a timeline first: the endings come from its transcript.
voice_pick: Pick an ending on the left.
voice_facts: At {time} · pitch over the last words: {shape} ({delta:+.1f} semitones), ending {final:+.1f} from the speaker's usual pitch
voice_result: Pitch at the end: {before:+.1f} → {after:+.1f} semitones · length {ms:+d} ms{stretched} · place the patch at {at} on a track above the interview
voice_failed: No take said the words clearly. Try again, or use your recording.
voice_no_whisper: A Whisper model is needed to check the takes: transcribe any timeline once with Whisper (it downloads the model), then try again.
review_tt_copy_ai2: The whole story, cut by cut, as text for an AI chat: it answers with a corrected story you bring back with Import AI story
review_tt_import_ai: Bring back the corrected story the AI wrote
review_get_audio_tt: Rebuilds the timeline's audio from DaVinci Resolve: this project must be open there.
review_getting_audio: Getting the recording… this can take a minute.
review_tt_sounds_good: Tick this cut off; the list shows which ones you've checked
review_tt_before_more: Keep the next sentence too, so the clip before the cut ends later
review_tt_before_less: End the clip before the cut one sentence earlier
review_tt_before_drop: Take the clip before the cut out of the story
review_tt_after_more: Start the clip after the cut one sentence earlier
review_tt_after_less: Start the clip after the cut one sentence later
review_tt_after_drop: Take the clip after the cut out of the story
review_edit_note: Changes go to the story. {shortcut} undoes them.
review_done_drop: Clip taken out of the story
review_edit_unavailable: This review doesn't match the story, so it can't be changed from here. Open the Story page to edit it.
voice_use_tt: Send to Resolve then lays this patch on its own audio track at the right frame and mutes the original words under it (the picture stays).
voice_no_audio: The recording of this timeline isn't on disk any more (temporary files are cleared). Get it back to measure the endings.
voice_use_on: In the story: Send to Resolve places it.
voice_place_bridge: Voice patches need the direct connection to Resolve (Studio, External scripting: Local) to be placed.
voice_placed: {n} voice patch(es) placed on their own track; the original words are muted under them.
voice_place_failed: The voice patches couldn't be placed: {err}
review_use_whole_why: Makes the whole interview the story, in its recorded order. Nothing is moved or left out, so the only cuts to review are the ones made in Clean (fillers, retakes, long pauses). If nothing was cleaned, the clips simply follow each other and there is little to hear. For story cuts, build a story on the Story page.
review_get_failed: The recording couldn't be rebuilt. Open this project in DaVinci Resolve, then try again.
voice_intro2: Find what sounds wrong: endings that sound unfinished, passages that are hard to understand or incoherent, words you marked. Replace them with a version in the speaker's own voice, made by VoiceStudio.
voice_show_all_tt: Show every statement ending, also the ones that fall.
voice_edit_words_tt: By default VoiceStudio says the same words cleanly (without fillers and restarts). Change them to rewrite the passage.
voice_reset_tt: Back to the passage's own words, said cleanly.
voice_r_inaudible: next to a sound without words
voice_empty_endings: Measured from the recording once it is on disk.
voice_empty_tagged: Mark words To voice patch in Clean and they show here.
voice_pick_any: Pick something on the left to hear it and patch it.
voice_make_p_tt: VoiceStudio says these words in the speaker's voice (best of 3 takes); StoryCraft keeps the take that says them most clearly.
voice_p_result: {new} s in place of {old} s ({diff} s) · place the patch at {at} on a track above the interview
voice_rewrite_note: Rewritten: the patch says your words.
voice_len_short:
The new words take {d} s less than the words they replace.

Cut the extra time: the story closes up after the patch.
Keep the length: the original picture runs on under room tone.
voice_len_long:
The new words take {d} s more than the words they replace.

Make room: the picture holds under the patch (its last frames repeat; cover them with B-roll) and the rest of the story moves later.
Keep the length: the patch plays over the start of what follows.
voice_use_on_close: In the story: Send to Resolve places it, and the story follows the patch's length.
voice_no_words: Type the words the patch should say.
tt_det_voice: Passages a voice patch could fix: endings that sound unfinished, sentences that are hard to understand or incoherent, and words you marked To voice patch.
tt_det_voice_mark: Puts the To voice patch marker on these words (it keeps them in the story and colours nothing in Resolve). Undo takes it off.
msg_voice_marked: {count} words marked To voice patch: Voice patch lists them under Tagged by you.
msg_voice_no_color: No colour is free for the To voice patch marker: delete a custom marker in Settings.
review_tt_show_all: Only flagged cuts are listed. Any cut also opens by clicking it in the transcript or on the waveform.
review_tt_pause_tight: Almost no pause: the next words follow straight on
review_tt_pause_auto: StoryCraft's usual breath at a cut
review_tt_pause_airy: A longer pause, room to breathe
review_done_pause: Pause changed: listen to B again
msg_passage_one_block: Select words inside one block of the story (or switch to Recording) to fix them.
retr_same_msg:
{model} heard the same words again:
“{text}”

If that's not what is said, type the right words.
dlg_correct_msg: Type what is actually said. Only the text changes: the audio and the cuts stay as they are. Words you keep keep their timing; new words share the time of the ones they replace.
hint_m_mark_full: Click a word to mark it (drag to mark more)
hint_m_clear_full: Right-click a word to clear its mark (drag to clear more)
hint_m_select_full: Shift-drag to select a passage, then right-click it for more
hint_m_jump_full: {key} + right-click a word to put the playhead there
msg_story_no_sentence: Those words aren't in a sentence the story can use (cut in Clean?).
msg_story_left_out: Left {ids} out of the story ({key} undoes)
voice_search_tt: Find the words you want to patch: every sentence that contains them can be patched.
search_not_in_story: This match isn't in the story: showing the whole recording
story_legend_out: Grey: left out of the story
story_legend_tt: Shift-drag a passage and right-click it to add it to the story or leave it out.
voice_take_tt: Hear this take as B and use it as the patch
voice_take_failed: This take didn't say the words clearly
msg_voice_send_cut: Those words are cut or marked: clear their marks first to patch them.
msg_voice_send_skipped: {count} words already marked (cut or another mark) were left out of the passage.
sw_review_tt: Hear and judge every cut between the blocks
sw_avail_count: {blocks} passages not in the story · drag or +
sw_split_tt: Split this block in two here
sw_trim_first_tt: Leave the first sentence out (it goes to Available)
sw_trim_last_tt: Leave the last sentence out (it goes to Available)
sw_remove_tt: Remove from the story (its sentences go to Available)
sw_play_tt: Play this block from the recording
sw_cut_tt: Hear and judge this cut in Review
sw_join_tt: Join these two blocks: they follow each other in the recording
sw_drag_sentence_tt: Drag this sentence into the story
sw_add_tt: Add to the story, in recording order
sw_start_body: Pick a way in. Afterwards you can move, split, join and trim the blocks here, and add back anything from Available.
sw_start_ai_body: Copy the transcript, paste it into an AI chat and ask for a story; then bring its answer back with Import AI story.
sw_start_whole_body: Every passage in recorded order (parts tagged Avoid stay in Available). Then take out what you don't need.
sw_start_empty_body: Start with nothing and drag the passages you want from Available on the right, or add them with +.
sw_drop_here: Drag passages here from Available, or add them with +.
voice_rewrite_sentence_tt: Change the sentence's words: it opens as a passage you can rewrite entirely, then patch.
ai_voice_legend_tt: Words in this colour are synthetic speech (a voice patch in the story, made with VoiceStudio).
tt_wf_story: The story: arrange its blocks, add or leave out passages
tt_wf_clean: Mark fillers, errors and retakes on the story's text
back_to_story_tt_voice: The story is the hub: patch here, then go back to it.
back_to_story_tt_review: The story is the hub: review the cuts here, then go back to it.
sw_note_removed_cut: {id} moved to Available · cut added between {a} and {b}
review_tt_before_wmore: Keep one more word at the end of the clip before the cut
review_tt_before_wless: Drop the last word of the clip before the cut (a hesitation)
review_tt_after_wmore: Start the clip after the cut one word earlier
review_tt_after_wless: Drop the first word of the clip after the cut (a hesitation)
review_done_wless: “{w}” left out: listen to B again
review_tt_w_drop_end: Drop “{w}” at the end of the clip before the cut
review_tt_w_add_end: Add “{w}” at the end of the clip before the cut
review_tt_w_drop_start: Drop “{w}” at the start of the clip after the cut
review_tt_w_add_start: Add “{w}” at the start of the clip after the cut
tt_hub_story: The story: arrange its blocks, add or leave out passages
tt_hub_clean: Mark fillers, errors and retakes on the story's text
tt_hub_review: Hear and fix every cut of the story
tt_hub_voice: Patch what sounds wrong with VoiceStudio
ver_tt_button: Save this story as a version, compare versions, go back to one
ver_sub: The stories you kept for this timeline. Restore one to go back to it; {undo} undoes a restore.
ver_tt_save: Keep the story as it is now, with a name
ver_empty: No versions yet. “Save this version…” keeps the story as it is now; StoryCraft also keeps one each time you send the story to Resolve or import an AI story.
ver_tt_compare: See what differs from the story now
ver_tt_restore: Make this version the story (the story now is kept as a version; {undo} undoes it)
ver_compare_hint: Press Compare on a version to see how it differs from the story now.
ver_no_diff: The two stories are the same.
ver_d_removed: Block {a} is no longer in the story
rt_need_native: Reloading needs the direct connection to DaVinci Resolve (Studio, External scripting: Local) with this project open.
rt_no_story: Open the transcript and its story first.
rt_nothing_sent: Nothing was sent to Resolve from this transcript yet: Send to Resolve first, edit that timeline, then reload it.
rt_read_failed: Couldn't read the timeline from Resolve: {err}
rt_empty: No StoryCraft clips were found in “{name}”.
rt_both_title: The story changed in both places
rt_both_intro: Since the last Send, “{name}” was edited in Resolve and the story was changed in StoryCraft. Below: what the timeline from Resolve changes compared with the story now.
rt_resolve_intro: Below: what the timeline from Resolve changes compared with the story now. The story now stays in Versions either way.
rt_outside: {n} clip(s) StoryCraft didn't lay (B-roll, other media) stay in Resolve as they are.
rt_dups: Words used twice in the timeline are in the story once.
rt_legacy: This timeline was sent before StoryCraft flagged its clips: every clip of the interview was read.
rt_tt_transcribe: Start a new transcript from the edited timeline
rt_tt_sync_resolve: Send the story now to Resolve as a new timeline
rt_tt_sync_storycraft: Take the timeline from Resolve as the story (the story now stays in Versions)
rt_keep_version: Keep it as a version only
rt_tt_keep_version: Save the timeline from Resolve in Versions without changing the story
rt_tt_use_resolve: Take the timeline from Resolve as the story (the story now stays in Versions)
rt_same: Resolve has the same story as StoryCraft.
rt_used: The story now follows “{name}” ({key} undoes; the previous story is in Versions)
rt_kept: The timeline from Resolve is in Versions; the story didn't change.
rt_transcribe_hint: “{name}” is the current timeline in Resolve: start the transcription to make it a new story.
rt_button_tt: Bring back the timeline you sent, after editing it by hand in Resolve: it becomes a version you can compare and use
sw_ai_menu_tt: Build or adjust the story with an AI chat: copy the transcript for it, then import the story it writes
tt_hub_versions: The stories you kept: compare them, go back to one, reload a timeline from Resolve
start_skip_transcript: Skip the transcript: cut pauses only  →
tt_start_skip_transcript: Detect and cut the silences without transcribing (no story, no text to edit)
tt_start_back_transcribe: Back to transcribing: the transcript is what the story is built from
sw_compare_same: Comparing with “{name}”: the story is the same.
sw_compare_with: Comparing with “{name}”: {summary}. The marks on the blocks show where.
voice_found_plain: {bad} of {all} sentences end as if unfinished
voice_whole_interview_tt: Also list what lies outside the story. Off: only what the story uses.
voice_all_endings_tt: Also list the sentences that end as finished.
voice_empty_story: Nothing in the story ({count} in the whole interview).
undo_what_voice: a voice patch in or out of the story
send_empty_msg: Nothing is in the story yet, so Send to Resolve would build the whole interview (cleaned). Send the whole interview?
send_done: Sent to Resolve as “{name}” (kept in Versions).
tt_home_back_open: The transcript you have open, where you left it
sw_more_tt: More: build the story from the script, clear the story
tt_video_hide: Hide the video (the waveform takes the room)
tt_video_none: Show the video area (this timeline has no video of its own: audio only)
tt_hub_ai: Every AI helper in one place: Claude connected, AI chats, the AI's marks
ai_intro: Every AI helper in one place. Nothing here changes the story by itself: you bring an answer back, and ⌘Z undoes it.
ai_mcp_body: With the StoryCraft connector, Claude Desktop or Claude Code reads the transcript and builds or adjusts the story right here. Ask it, for example: “Read the transcript and build a 2-minute story about the garden.”
ai_chat_story_title: Build or adjust the story with an AI chat
ai_chat_story_body: Copy the transcript, paste it into any AI chat and ask for a story; bring its answer back with Import. The story you had stays in Versions.
ai_chat_cuts_title: Check the cuts with an AI chat
ai_chat_cuts_body: Copy every cut of the story as text: the AI says which ones jar and answers with a corrected story you bring back with Import.
ai_marks_body: The fillers, retakes and errors the AI found when transcribing. Put them all back here; each kind has its own Restore in Clean (Found).
ai_mcp_on: ● The connector is on: StoryCraft is ready for Claude.
ai_mcp_off: ○ The connector is off (Settings › AI assistants).
ai_copied_story: Transcript copied: paste it into your AI chat.
ai_restored: The AI's marks are back ({key} undoes).
tt_ai_connect_desktop: Add StoryCraft to Claude Desktop's settings (a backup is kept)
tt_ai_copy_code_cmd: Paste it in a terminal once
ai_mcp_body2: Connect Claude once: then, with StoryCraft open, ask Claude in a chat, for example: “Read the transcript and build a 2-minute story about the garden.” It builds the story here and can send it to Resolve.
ai_mcp_down: ○ The connector didn't start: reopen StoryCraft.
ai_desk_ok: ✓ Claude Desktop is set up (restart it if you just connected it).
ai_desk_other: ! Claude Desktop points to another copy of StoryCraft: Connect fixes it.
ai_desk_bad: ! Claude Desktop's settings file can't be read: fix it by hand.
ai_desk_missing: ○ Claude Desktop isn't set up yet.
ai_code_other: ! Claude Code points to another copy of StoryCraft: run the command again.
ai_desk_done: Claude Desktop is connected. Quit and reopen Claude Desktop to use it.
ai_code_copied: Command copied: paste it in a terminal, then start Claude Code.
voice_takes_hint: Click a take to use it as the patch
sw_hint_correct_full: Double-click a line to correct its words
sw_hint_play_full: {key} + click a line to play from that sentence
sw_hint_menu_full: Right-click a line for its menu
sw_hint_title: The mouse on the story's lines
voice_delivery_tt: How the patch is said: how it ends, its pitch, its pace and its sound.
voice_dl_ending_tt: Falls: a finished statement. Rises: a question, or a thought that goes on. As recorded: like the speaker said it here.
voice_dl_pitch_tt: StoryCraft tunes the patch to the speaker's pitch around it. − and + make it lower or higher, half a semitone at a time.
voice_dl_pace_tt: How fast VoiceStudio says the words. Slower or faster patches keep their pace when they are fitted.
voice_dl_sound_tt: Match the room: the patch gets the recording's tone and room noise. Clean: the voice alone, at the same loudness.
voice_dl_no_rise_ref: No rising sentence nearby to copy the melody from: the nearest sentence was used, so the rise may be weak.
voice_dl_no_fall_ref: No falling sentence nearby to copy the melody from: the nearest sentence was used.
msg_patches_left_out: {n} voice patch(es) left out: the story no longer holds all the words they replace (Voice patch shows them).
review_patch_note: Check the joins of the patch you inserted.
review_patch_back: Back to Voice patch to pick another take
review_tt_patch_open_voice: Pick another take of this patch, or take it out of the story
review_patch_edit_note: To change it, pick another take on Voice patch.
review_patch_a_desc: The original words, as they were said
review_patch_b_desc: The join with the AI voice, as the story plays it
review_patch_tip: Listen for a jump in loudness, tone or timing where the AI voice meets the recording.
sw_cleared_patches: Story cleared, voice patches taken out ({key} undoes)
home_more_tt: More: start fresh with this timeline
msg_saved_exists_desc2: "{timeline}" was transcribed before (saved {when}). Open that work, or start fresh? Starting fresh puts the earlier transcript, story, versions and voice patches in the archive (nothing in Resolve changes).
fresh_nothing: Nothing saved for “{tl}”: it already starts fresh.
fresh_msg: StoryCraft puts this timeline's saved work in the archive: {what}. Nothing in Resolve changes. Then transcribe the timeline again to start from scratch.
fresh_done: “{tl}” starts fresh. The earlier work is in the archive folder (StoryCraft › saves › archive).
ver_tt_delete_all: Delete every version of this timeline ({undo} undoes)
ver_delete_all_msg: Delete all {n} versions of this timeline? The story itself stays as it is; {undo} brings them back.
tt_player_recording: Hear the original recording instead of the story (turns off when you change page)
tt_player_recording_no_story: There's no story yet: the player plays the recording.
player_recording_banner: Playing the original recording — not the story. Turn off Play original to hear the story.
player_no_story: No story yet · playing the recording
clean_no_story_hint: Build a story on the Story page; Clean then shows just the story.
st_tt_recording: The player plays the raw recording, not the story. Click to play the story again
st_tt_length: How long the story plays, voice patches included. Click: the story
st_tt_blocks: The story's blocks. Click: arrange them on the Story page
st_tt_no_story: Nothing is in the story yet. Click: build it on the Story page
st_tt_patches: Voice patches playing in the story. Click: Voice patch
st_tt_cuts: Cuts the review flags as worth a listen. Click: Review cuts
st_tt_in_resolve: Resolve has this exact story. Click: Send options
st_tt_changed: The story changed since it was sent to Resolve. Click: send it again, or reload what was edited in Resolve
st_tt_not_sent: This story hasn't been sent to Resolve yet. Click: send it
st_tt_resolve_offline: DaVinci Resolve isn't connected. Open Resolve Studio with a project and set Preferences > System > General > External scripting to Local; in the free Resolve, run Workspace > Scripts > StoryCraft Bridge. Click: connect again
st_tt_length_target: How long the story plays, voice patches included. Click: set its target length
clean_rec_hint: Clean shows your story. To see or hear the whole recording, turn on {switch} in the player.
clean_fold_cut_one: 1 word removed by the cut settings
clean_fold_cut_n: {n} words removed by the cut settings
track_options_hint: The tracks Send to Resolve puts in the timeline.
voice_words_reading: Reading the patch's words so the transcript follows its rhythm…
